[[File:Night_Spirit.jpg|thumb|right|275px|The [[Stranger]], a [[Wizard of the Night Spirit]]]]
The '''Night Spirit''' was an evil [[Deity/Legends|deity]] in the beliefs of various groups on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. It was worshiped by the [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] but feared by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].

According to Ewok belief, the Night Spirit came to Endor in a [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]]. The Ewoks of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] believed that the Spirit desired the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]] so that it could raise the spirits of evil beings on Endor. The Night Spirit sometimes appeared to believers in a ghostlike form. The deity feared the Ewoks' [[Tree of Light]], which kept it at bay during daylight hours. The Ewoks believed that the [[Lantern of Sacred Light]] also kept the Night Spirit away. They also believed the native dragon-like [[Condor dragon/Legends|mantigrues]] served this evil deity.
